name: Mindful meditation
title: Mindful meditation
doneText: Complete. I am not the body, I am not even the mind.

lede.guided: Read it once, press Begin, and close your eyes. The guru sets up the posture, breathes the thought with you for a minute, counts the seven sounds and closes the sit. Don't stop in the middle.
lede.silent: Bells only, plus a three-word cue for the sound. Learn the three stages below first; you'll do them without being talked through.

facts: Cross-legged, spine comfortably erect. A backrest is fine; no headrest.
On the thighs, palms facing up.
Slightly upturned, eyes closed, a mild focus between the eyebrows.
release: Three ingredients: your breath, your thought and your awareness. Combined the right way, they make the body and mind far more capable. Not superhuman; simply fully human.
guidelines: Ignore whatever the mind and body do during the sit. Simply sit.
Don't take a break in the middle. Do all three stages in one go.
At least 12 minutes each time: twice a day for 48 days (one mandala), or once a day for 90 days.
Any time during the day, you can remind yourself: I am not the body, I am not even the mind.
This practice follows Isha Kriya, which Isha Foundation teaches free at isha.sadhguru.org. This app is a personal practice timer and isn't affiliated with them.

guided.name: Posture
guided.read: Settle into the posture. The guru then explains the one thought that carries the whole practice.

guided.name: Breath and thought
guided.read: Inhale gently, silently saying “I am not the body.” Exhale gently, “I am not even the mind.” Each breath lasts as long as its thought. The guru breathes it with you for about a minute, then checks in every few minutes.

guided.name: Aaah, seven times
guided.read: Mouth wide open, exhale fully into a long “Aaah” from just below the navel, loud enough to feel the vibration. Seven times; the guru counts.

guided.name: Stillness
guided.read: Face slightly up, a mild focus between the eyebrows. Ignore whatever the mind and body do, and simply sit. One brief check-in halfway.

guided.name: Close
guided.read: Take your time, then open the eyes very slowly.

silent.name: Breath and thought
silent.read: A bell starts it. Inhale: “I am not the body.” Exhale: “I am not even the mind.” No voice, no check-ins.

silent.name: Aaah, seven times
silent.read: A bell and a three-word cue. Seven long “Aaah”s from just below the navel; count them yourself.

silent.name: Stillness
silent.read: A bell. Face slightly up, a mild focus between the eyebrows. Simply sit. Three bells end it.

say.intro: Today... the kriya. Very simple... very powerful. Sit cross-legged... spine comfortably erect. A backrest is fine... a headrest, no. Hands on the thighs... palms up. Lift the face... just slightly. Eyes closed... and a mild focus... between the eyebrows.
say.teach: Here is the whole secret. Breathing in... silently say... I am not the body. Breathing out... I am not even the mind. Let each breath last... as long as its thought. Gently. No forcing.
say.kout: I am not even the mind...
say.own: Now... continue on your own. Same thought... same gentle breath. I will check in.
say.check_1: Still with me? Good. Breathing in... I am not the body. Breathing out... I am not even the mind. Let the breath be as long... as the thought.
say.check_2: If the mind has wandered off... no problem. It always comes back... usually hungry. Gently... I am not the body... I am not even the mind.
say.check_3: Long... gentle breaths. The thought rides on the breath... like a passenger who knows the way.
say.aaa_intro: Now... the sound. Open the mouth wide... and from just below the navel... let out a long Aaah... with the whole breath. Loud enough to feel it vibrate. Seven times. I will count... you do the singing.
say.still_intro: Now... sit still. Face slightly up... a mild focus between the eyebrows. Whatever the mind does... whatever the body does... ignore it. Let them gossip. You... simply sit.
say.still_check: Still sitting? Good. Nothing to do... nowhere to go. Just... this.
say.close: Take your time... Slowly... very slowly... open the eyes.
say.complete: Well done. Through the day... whenever you remember... I am not the body. I am not even the mind.
